text.11:78: And his people came unto him, running towards him - and before then they used to commit abominations - He said: O my people! Here are my daughters! They are purer for you. Beware of Allah, and degrade me not in (the person of) my guests. Is there not among you any upright man?
text.15:51: And tell them of Abraham's guests,
text.15:68: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!
text.51:24: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
text.54:37: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
